snippet.title: MAGEYE Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
In an increasingly oppressive world, a magpie feeds her only remaining child in a world of lacklustre sightseers.
Take their vision and feed your son.

DEMO OUT ON STEAM AND ITCH.IO:

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3658230/MAGEYE/
Itch.io: https://deadzeros.itch.io/mageye


Gameplay Summary:
Experience a blend of fast-paced arcade action and narrative storytelling. Switch between reflex-driven eye-stealing combat and unsettling visual novel segments. Navigate a decaying cityscape, collect "eyes" before bringing them back to your nest, and progress through increasingly hostile environments shaped by humanity’s ignorance and excess.

Features:
-    Eye-catching, palatable arcade action.
-    Black and white pixelated visuals with a modernised retro Atari aesthetic.
-    Visual novel segments filled with detailed drawings and animations.
-    Two-leggeds designed with close accordance to the stupidity of their real-life counterparts.
-    A city inspired by real world habitable landfills.
-    Dystopian advertisements.
-    Excessive amounts of corpses.
-    Dark, edgy humor to make nasty sights easier to swallow.
-    Vomit-inducing audio.
-    An overabundance of eyes, ripe for picking.




YOUR VENGEANCE WILL BE VIRTUOUS.

#PsychologicalHorror #IndieGame #SteamGame #HorrorGame
